description: Dockerfile security & best-practice lint — Static security and best-practice check for a Dockerfile (dockerfile= URL-encoded text, or url= https link to a raw Dockerfile): root user, secrets baked into ENV/ARG, curl-pipe-to-shell, unpinned or latest base images, remote ADD without checksum, sudo, chmod 777, exposed SSH, apt/pip/npm/apk hygiene, shell-form CMD/ENTRYPOINT, missing HEALTHCHECK. Multi-stage aware. Returns findings with line numbers and fixes, score, A-F grade and verdict OK / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE SHIPPING / BLOCK. Offline, no image pull. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

dockerfile.description: FROM node:latest  RUN curl -sL https://x.sh | bash  CMD node server.js

name: security_dockerfile_check
